Wormface temple

Setting

The Wormface temple gives Kir access to a people who recognise his Joon ancestry. The Brainripper invokes an ancient compact, but information and access still require action on the travellers’ part. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Defending the Shelter and the ancient treaty

An imperial scout discovers the Shelter. After fighting the expedition, Khatul proposes placing Wormface bodies at the battlefield to conceal the brotherhood’s involvement. In the depths, Brainripper recognises Kir as a Joon and invokes an ancient treaty. He demands the death of a necromancer disturbing the caves before granting access. Later he calls Kir mentally and offers information for rescuing the Priest of Silence from the necromancers. His account of a human searching for Joon remains gives another lead, though he cannot say where that man now lives. The alliance is reciprocal and conditional, not a promise to answer every question. [5, 6, 2, 3, 7, 8, 4, 9]
